orders.thesis: Supply-driven gap (insiders sold 8M shares at 14.50, 18% below the prior close) has retraced from 14.40 to 15.59 with no company news; the 14.50 offering price, company buyback at that price and greenshoe act as support. Analyst PTs 18-22 intact. Stop moved up under the offering price (14.40) so the loss is bounded at the thesis line; target raised to 17 as the retrace continues.
orders.wrong_if: ARDT closes below the 14.50 offering price, meaning the supply was not absorbed.

orders.thesis: Stock round-tripped the R&D Day rally after the CMO/R&D head resigned and a price-fixing settlement; strategy and guidance unchanged, 9 buy ratings with median PT ~50. It has bounced from 38.54 to 39.98 and the exec-exit overhang should keep fading. Stop tightened to just below the post-news low area; target raised toward the pre-resignation 44.5 area.
orders.wrong_if: TEVA breaks below ~37.5 or the company cuts guidance or reports another senior pipeline departure.

summary:
Session 2026-11-24. Market: violent AI-bubble regime. 11-23 SPY +4.71% (722.29), QQQ +7%, NVDA +31.5%. Pre-market 11-24 gives part back: SPY -1.5%, QQQ -2.4%, XLK -3.4%, semis -3 to -7%, ADI -12% (guide), HPE -12%, ANT below its 83 IPO price (82.65, now shortable). Retail earnings gap up hard (DKS +16%, ANF +10%, DLTR +8%, BURL +7.6%).

Book: ARDT long 3.8% (15.59, +8.5%), TEVA long 3.1% (39.98, +3.8%), WCN long 7% (181.57, +0.9%, horizon 11-27), FIS short 5.4% (26.73, +10%, stop 28.18, horizon 11-30, FIS pre +0.6%). Only actions: extended ARDT (stop 14.40 under offering price, target ~17, horizon 6d) and TEVA (stop ~37.5, target ~43.5, horizon 7d). No new positions.

Examined and passed: INSM (Sanofi $175 cash, 2.4% spread, no); SNY; ADI (guide-driven, sector also -4%, p~0.5); DKS/ANF/DLTR/BURL (gap-up open entries); SHOE (-22% miss, small cap, 0.5% slippage); HPE/SMTC/DELL (AI giveback); CHA (-15.8% was a special-dividend ex-date, data trap); VOD (Citi sell); ASH (Clariant/CD&R talks at no premium); OTLY (+109% on a $4.13 Verlinvest tender both sides reject, fair value unclear, squeeze risk); ANT (support near 83 vs AI stress, 50/50); CRWD/ZS (arb).

Next session: check WCN (horizon 11-27 requires a decision, target 191.39), FIS stop, ANT close vs 83, whether retail earnings gap-ups held, OTLY and ABVX follow-through, SPY vs 689.81 low. Only trade at p>=0.55 with real size.
feedback: No tool failures. Two suggestions. (1) The screen's pre-market column and the quotes tool sometimes disagree (BURL +7.8% vs a headline saying it tumbled) and the 1d % is not adjusted for special dividends (CHA -15.8% was an ex-dividend date). A flag for ex-dividend dates on the screen would stop wasted research on false 'down, no news' rows. (2) The digest's top-gainer list only shows one stock; a fuller top-loser list with news flags would help. Also it would help if get_quotes showed 'time since last trade' for stale IEX prints.
